name: Jetmall Spices and Masala Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2012, Jetmall Spices & Masala Ltd manufactures & trades food and processed foods[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company does trading in Spices, Masala, Food Grains and Kirana products. It operates with its large format high street exclusive showrooms located at chennai and has also launched its own ecommerce website www.habiton.in to cater to the B2C segment

cons: Stock is trading at 2.97 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.

The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -54.8% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -1.18% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 1,761 days.
Working capital days have increased from 2,444 days to 4,030 days
